# TKC Talent

> TKC Talent by The Kabir Company — India's trusted celebrity management and artist booking agency. Hire Bollywood actors, singers, comedians, DJs and influencers for weddings, corporate events and brand campaigns.

TKC Talent has 20+ years of experience booking A-list Indian talent for events across India and worldwide. Transparent pricing, end-to-end logistics, quotes within 48 hours.
